\subsection{Reproducible equation-level calculations}
The accompanying \texttt{verify\_equilibrium.py} reconstructs the finite resource generators and their pulse unitaries, the two null-reference matrices, the captured-feedback probabilities, all twelve one-site Pauli detection identities for the four-qubit code, and the noncommuting transported-trap identity. It also simplifies the moving-Gaussian Schr\"odinger residual to zero and evaluates the displayed first-crossing density. These are fresh checks of the formulas used here; they do not rely on the earlier release's supplementary scripts or saved numerical results.
authoritative:
\subsection{Finite numerical values}
The finite example is determined by the displayed resource rotations, reference matrices and classifier integrals. The twelve one-site Pauli detection identities follow from anticommutation with the stabilizers; the moving-Gaussian residual and transported-trap identity were proved above. No supplementary computation is needed for these proof steps.
